verdict.reader_note: The text is complete and in the right order, with headwords and the double-line notes correctly sequenced, but it carries about five character misreads in names and titles (盈丈, 石淙, 尹大, 汎小䑳, 蘇瓌) and four junk characters at the top from the clipped margin title.
